# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Docs first (MANDATORY)

**ALL code generated by Claude Code MUST ALWAYS first refer to the relevant docs file within the `/docs` directory before any code is written.** Read the applicable file(s) and follow their standards exactly.

- `docs/auth.md` — Authentication standards (Clerk only, server-side `auth()`, route protection, sign-in/up UI). Read before touching anything auth-related.
- `docs/data-fetching.md` — Data fetching and DB access standards (server components only, `/data` helpers with Drizzle, no raw SQL, users only see their own data). Read before fetching or mutating any data.
- `docs/data-mutations.md` — Data mutation standards (`/data` Drizzle helpers, server actions in colocated `actions.ts`, typed params, no `FormData`, zod validation). Read before writing any insert/update/delete.
- `docs/ui.md` — UI coding standards (shadcn/ui components only, date-fns date formatting). Read before writing or changing any UI.

## Status

Freshly scaffolded from Create Next App; no application code beyond the starter page yet.

## Commands

- `npm run dev` — dev server at http://localhost:3000
- `npm run build` / `npm run start` — production build / serve
- `npm run lint` — ESLint (flat config in `eslint.config.mjs`, uses `eslint-config-next`)

No test runner is configured.

## Stack and setup notes

- Next.js 16 (App Router) with React 19 and TypeScript. Source lives in `src/app/`.
- Path alias: `@/*` → `./src/*`.
- Tailwind CSS v4 is wired through Turbopack in `next.config.ts` (`@tailwindcss/turbopack` loader applied to `*.css`), not through a PostCSS config. Styles are set up via `@import "tailwindcss"` in `src/app/globals.css`.
- Theme colors are CSS variables (`--background`, `--foreground`) in `globals.css`, with a `prefers-color-scheme: dark` override, exposed to Tailwind via `@theme inline`. Fonts are Geist, loaded with `next/font` in `src/app/layout.tsx`.
